notes.title: Happy Birthday, Goodbye Volcano High!
notes.content:
*huge inhale*

It's the one year anniversary of Goodbye Volcano High! Our little dinogang has been out in the world for a whole year! 365 days of all dinos all the time! A full trip around the dang sun!!! That's us!!🎤 🦖

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38023570/a31bd982f1f2299c2b7f9adacb5bf7ddfe1ff2b0.jpg

An entire year of memes and plushies and headcanons and fanart and AWARDS and really lovely reviews  and some truly bonkers shout outs from others in the games industry we look up to and admire 😭😭😭

To celebrate, the studio doodled the number one nonbinary pterosaur rockstar, Fang!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38023570/a54643dd96b23f55c1511792ab6fec8585ba1358.jpg

It's been a wild year. The amount of support and love for the game that we've seen across reviews, awards, and social media has been overwhelming. Our team poured our hearts into this game and to see this response to work that has so much of us in it is validating, humbling, and staggering. 

Thank you to every person who played our game; everyone who saw themselves in our characters.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38023570/94ef59fe959f9e46b8348410980e58f2d6aa4ad4.png

Finally, we've got some exciting news for y'all—NEW GVH MERCH is available from our friends at The Yetee!!! Two new designs, Fang's iconique Goodbye shirt—as both a t-shirt and a tank top—and a tarot-inspired design of the whole crew are now available!!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38023570/4acf130086f5f217c0292b7e983095c1436d151a.jpg

Happy birthday, Goodbye Volcano High!! 🌈 🦕 To another year of queer + trans sad but still hopeful dinos!! 🥂

Thank you again for everything, y'all!! 🌟

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38023570/22492aa7e5be480661a81f041fbf90d947de6435.jpg

notes.title: Hot Off the Presses, Patch 1.06 is Here! 🙌🏼
notes.content:
The devs have been hard at work in the Goodbye Volcano High patch update mines, and we’re so excited to share it with you!


All Platforms



 Fixed “A Different Kind of Album” achievement/trophy—old players who were previously bugged may need to get missing photos again to complete this.
 Added the ability to maintain photo progress across playthroughs—go to Settings and toggle on “All-Time Photo Collection” to activate this.
 Reduced affinity requirements for seeing Trish’s final scene and unlocking her final photos.
 Reduced affinity requirements for unlocking Reed’s final photo.
 Updated final lyrics writing minigame to work as it was originally meant to—player only chooses two lines to change, with the original two lines carrying over from previous lyrics writing minigame.
 Fixed Battle of the Bands minigames overlapping if autoplay is toggled off.
 Cleaned up compression artifacts on certain character’s faces (Ms. Roberts, Naser, Trish) when playing at resolutions under 4K.
 Added user icons to social media posts.
 Fixed various camera placement and zoom issues.
 Fixed various issues with VO getting cut off.
 Fixed various issues with Affinity icon not appearing when it should or appearing at the wrong time.
 Fixed rare issues with settings not applying correctly, reverting back to default, and having mismatched button states.
 Fixed “static” choice bubbles occasionally staying onscreen after being selected.
 Fixed the episode 6 montage music not respecting master/music audio settings.
 Fixed subtitle colour setting not respecting LnL text.
Fixed VO toggle not affecting LnL character VO. 

Thank y’all so much for your bug reports—we really appreciate your help! <3 If you have reports, send them our way at support [@] ko-op [dot] com 🌟

PS: GVH is verified on Steam Deck for all your on-the-go queer dino needs! Happy gaming, y’all!

notes.title: Save & Sound - A celebration of music in games is going live September 11 - 14!
notes.content:
Get ready!

Join us September 11 - 14 right here on Steam for one of the largest digital expos about audio and music in games. Save & Sound features concerts, deep-dives, and mashups from 70+ developers from around the world!

Starting at 10:00 AM PDT / 7:00 PM CEST, a 3-day live show from September 11 - 13 will showcase original content made just for Save & Sound. 

Goodbye Volcano High is a story-driven, choice-based cinematic adventure game about personal growth, acceptance, and the power of community. What will you do at the end of an era? 

Join us Tuesday, September 12th at 1:00 PM PDT / 10:00 PM CEST for an exclusive deep dive into "Going Away" ft. Lachlan Watson and Brigitte Naggar!

Don’t miss out on updates!

Set a reminder to be notified when Save & Sound will go live!

The show will be streamed on the Save & Sound website, YouTube, and Twitch. Check out all the games part of the event on saveandsound.io

notes.title: Thanks for Tribeca & Steam Next Fest! Keep Our Demo!
notes.content:
Hi everybody! 👋

A little update as to the GVH store page. Coming off Tribeca and Steam Next Fest, we wanted to keep our demo up so that anyone who missed out gets a chance to play it! 

Some notes on this demo for those who didn’t play it when it came out!


 Our first demo premiered on Steam for LudoNarraCon 2023 and featured the first 4 scenes of Goodbye Volcano High. In that demo, there were two rhythm gameplay sequences and one minigame.
 This demo features the end of Episode 1 as well as the first five scenes of Episode 2. While there isn’t rhythm gameplay in this demo, there are two minigames. And the asteroid finally makes its introduction! 😱
 The demo requires a controller to play. We know some players are frustrated by this so we really apologize for the inconvenience, but don't worry, the final game will have full keyboard functionality!
 This demo was originally made for Tribeca (and our last one was for PAX East) all the way back in March! So a lot of bug fixes, audio, and polish are missing. The final release will have all these things, but since the demo scenes were forked so long ago, it's hard to update demos with all the new changes when the team is working on finalizing the game.


Thank you so much, and if you haven’t yet had the chance to play, we hope you’ll get to now that we’re keeping it up! And tell your friends all about it too—the dinos thank you 💖

notes.title: Dev Update + Demo News!
notes.content:
Starting our dev update off with what's important lol: All the KO_OP staff members have their own dinosona now; a lot of them are actually in this picture, at a big concert on the roof of the school. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38023570/2eb19eb02ca2248a8ce3aeaa8e1645430dd873a5.png

Our animation team is on a strict wrap schedule that has all their remaining work mapped out for the rest of the game. The animations have been split up into two categories: poses or in-betweens (sound off in the comments if you wanna learn more about this process). We’re also down to just a few pick-up lines of dialogue before we fully wrap on VO, which is huge, and our background art team is almost done, with only two members of our background art team remaining 🥺 It’s so bittersweet to off-board team members from a game as it wraps up! Right now, the name of the game is integration: getting alllll those assets into Unity. Our integration team is so efficient right now it's wild, and we've gotten an assist from our Team Pilgrim programmers (in case you missed it: we operate under a "two team" format, where one team is making a game while another is in concept development so we always have something on the go. We're Team Fang, in case you missed that).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38023570/6f147af9bc202382191765e735e4ba9fd5d1b150.png

In addition to our dev updates though, we've finally been able to get Goodbye Volcano High into people's hands! Not the full game of course, but our demo! In March we had our first opportunities to get hands-on thoughts from other game developers at GDC's Day of the Devs, where we were one of a handful of games curated for the event, and at PAX East, which was the first time consumers got their claws on the Goodbye Volcano High demo.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38023570/9d405f2154047acd5075b516fae4df6d353b3304.png
Thanks @wolfnanaki for this amazing round up of all the press on GVH's demo!

Getting to hear all your thoughts and all the things people were excited about was like a balm on our weary souls! We can't thank you enough. We were, however, very sorry our online dino delegates didn't get a chance to play the demo 💔 Wouldn't you know it though, that's all about to change...

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38023570/0d32469684a07831cdd3d30d7079b44d98dd7e02.png

Because we are proud to announce that the first online demo for Goodbye Volcano High will make its debut at LudoNarraCon this coming May 4th-8th! YES THAT'S RIGHT DINOS. It’ll be here on Steam. 

It's so overwhelmingly wonderful to get to be a part of LudoNarraCon. I remember watching talks the past few years and being so impressed with the way they run this fest, and the types of games they highlight. It's so special. And now we're in the mix! We're so honoured.

It's been a big month for us, dinos! The whole development team has been hard at work finishing this darn game, and it's looking so beautiful. We really can't wait for you to see it.

notes.title: Goodbye Volcano High Release Date Update + Teaser
notes.content:
As many of you have likely guessed, Goodbye Volcano High will not be making its targeted 2022 release. We have made the difficult decision to push its launch to Summer of 2023.

This has been a learning experience for us: producing an ambitious project for our studio's size, with over 6000 voiced lines, and a large number of bespoke animations. We care about this game and the story we're telling so much, and want to deliver something that is in line with what we've always envisioned for this game. It's what you deserve!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38023570/c9b900c29b86dcbc710559376fb9fd37e9361817.png

We understand this delay might be disappointing, but we are confident this is the right decision and that it will be worth the wait.

In the meantime, we hope you enjoy this teaser trailer — it's a sneak peek of what we've been working on for the past little while! 

[previewyoutube=VqpRNQGHB_o;full][/previewyoutube]
If you’re intrigued and haven’t joined our community, you can become a member of our Discord or follow us on TikTok, Twitter, and Instagram, where we’ll be continuing to post even more updates on all or most of these channels in the New Year. 

The whole team at KO_OP is beyond excited for everyone to play Goodbye Volcano High when it’s ready, and we thank you so much for your patience.

----

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38023570/648454b3a826f23af182ad6fe536f6aa4f843ba2.png

You can find the full version of the song featured in our teaser ("Don't Call" by Dabu ft Brigitte Nagger) on YouTube or Bandcamp. 😘
